supplements.title: 12‑weeks fisetin supplementation and interval resistance with aerobic training: changes in Maresin‑1 and inflammatory markers in men with obesity: a randomized controlled trial.
supplements.summary: Fisetin supplements combined with exercise training increased inflammation-resolving molecules and improved metabolic health in obese men.

supplements.title: Effects of Exercise on Cancer-Related Cognitive Impairment: An Umbrella Review of Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis.
supplements.summary: Exercise may help reduce memory and attention problems that cancer survivors experience after treatment.

supplements.title: Integrative Database-Driven In Silico and In Vitro Study of Anemarrhena asphodeloides Bunge Highlighting Hippeastrine as a Regulator of the HSP90/PI3K/Akt/mTOR Axis in Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Hippeastrine, a compound from a plant extract, kills oral cancer cells by blocking a key growth pathway called HSP90/PI3K/Akt/mTOR.

supplements.title: Advances in extraction, purification, and pharmacological mechanisms of calycosin: a comprehensive review.
supplements.summary: Calycosin from Astragalus shows promise against cancer and inflammation through multiple cellular pathways with low toxicity.

supplements.title: Resveratrol's hepatic symphony: conducting a multi-stage intervention in liver cancer's progression.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol, a natural plant compound, shows promise fighting liver cancer by blocking multiple disease stages from inflammation to tumor growth.

supplements.title: Formula Probiotic Fermentation After Enzymatic Pretreatment Enhances Immunomodulatory Effects of Edible Seaweed Sargassum fusiforme via Gut Microbial Regulation.
supplements.summary: Fermented seaweed polysaccharides boost immune function by increasing beneficial gut bacteria and their protective metabolites.

supplements.title: Zerumbone Induces Apoptosis and Inhibits Migration of A2058 Melanoma stem-like Cells by Producing Reactive Oxygen Species, Causing G2/M Cell Cycle Arrest, and Controlling the Expression of Genes Linked to Metastasis.
supplements.summary: Zerumbone kills melanoma cancer cells by triggering cell death, stopping cell division, and reducing cancer spread through reactive oxygen species production.

supplements.title: Bio-inspired self-assembly of omega-3 fatty acids and peptides for responsive drug delivery.
supplements.summary: Omega-3 fatty acid nanoparticles deliver cancer drugs on-demand when they encounter tumor-specific enzymes, reducing toxicity to healthy cells.

supplements.title: Low-dose Andrographolide Synergizes With Cytarabine or Vincristine in Plasma Cell Neoplasm Cell Lines.
supplements.summary: Low-dose andrographolide boosts the cancer-killing effects of two standard drugs in plasma cell neoplasm cells.

supplements.title: Scutellarein Induces Apoptosis in SCC-25 Oral Squamous Cell Carcinoma Cells Through Suppression of the PI3K/Akt Pathway.
supplements.summary: Scutellarein, a natural compound, kills oral cancer cells by blocking a protein pathway that normally helps tumors survive.

supplements.title: Unveiling the Anti-tumor Actions and Therapeutic Potential of Calcitriol in Colorectal Cancer.
supplements.summary: Vitamin D (calcitriol) reduces colorectal cancer growth by suppressing tumor cells and dampening pro-inflammatory immune responses, though optimal dosing remains unclear.

supplements.title: Ginsenoside Rh4 Induces Apoptosis Through ROS-Mediated Fas Signaling in Human Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma NPC/HK1 Cells.
supplements.summary: Ginsenoside Rh4, a ginseng compound, kills nasopharyngeal cancer cells by triggering a natural cell death pathway.

supplements.title: Enzalutamide Enhanced Honokiol-induced Apoptotic Insults to Drug-resistant Glioblastoma Cells via an Intrinsic Bak-mitochondrion-caspase Cascade Mechanism.
supplements.summary: Combining enzalutamide with honokiol kills drug-resistant glioblastoma cells by triggering programmed cell death through mitochondrial pathways.

supplements.title: Y-box Binding Protein 1 as a Target Molecule of a Novel Coumarin-based Anti-metastatic Agent.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified Y-box binding protein 1 as the target of a new coumarin compound that stops osteosarcoma cancer spread.

supplements.title: Effects of added-sugar warning labels on restaurant menus in the USA: an online randomised controlled trial.
supplements.summary: Warning labels on restaurant menus showing added sugar content can reduce how much sugar customers choose to consume.

off_label.title: Unveiling Remyelinating Properties of Roflumilast in CPZ-Induced Neuronal Demyelination in Mice.
off_label.summary: Roflumilast, a PDE-4 inhibitor, promotes remyelination and reduces inflammation in a mouse multiple sclerosis model.

off_label.title: Bevacizumab for Radiation-Induced (Radiculo)plexopathy.
off_label.summary: Bevacizumab shows promise as the first potential treatment for nerve damage that develops years after cancer radiation therapy.

off_label.title: Multi-omics reveals a novel Cxcr4+ subpopulation of alveolar macrophages and therapeutic effect of AMD3100 in mice with advanced silicosis.
off_label.summary: AMD3100 treatment reduces lung fibrosis in silicosis by targeting a specific immune cell population, offering a potential therapy for this occupational disease.

off_label.title: Potential Benefit of Sodium-Glucose Cotransporter 2-Inhibitors in Cisplatin-Associated Nephrotoxicity Among Patients With Cancer Having Diabetes Mellitus.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may protect kidneys from cisplatin damage in cancer patients with diabetes by reducing drug uptake in kidney cells.

off_label.title: The GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Liraglutide Promotes Anticancer Activities in MCF7 Breast and PC-3 Prostate Cancer Cells by Modulating Glycolysis, Oxidative Stress and Adipokines.
off_label.summary: Liraglutide, a diabetes drug, kills breast and prostate cancer cells by increasing oxidative stress and triggering cell death pathways.

off_label.title: Real-world Clinical Outcomes of Ivermectin and Mebendazole in Cancer Patients: Results from a Prospective Observational Cohort.
off_label.summary: Antiparasitic drugs ivermectin and mebendazole show promise as accessible, low-toxicity cancer treatments in real-world patient use.

off_label.title: Looming Concerns With Gabapentin Oversight: Balancing Safety and Access.
off_label.summary: Gabapentin regulation as a controlled substance may improve safety but risks limiting access for vulnerable patients needing pain relief.

off_label.title: Protocol for Neuro-Oncology Anywhere: Deploying Mayo Clinic's remote cognitive assessment battery and wearable device monitoring platform while assessing the impact of metformin on cognition and quality of life in patients with history of cranial radiation.
off_label.summary: Remote cognitive testing and metformin may help prevent cognitive decline in brain tumor patients treated with cranial radiation.

off_label.title: Drug repositioning in metastatic prostate cancer based on protein- protein interaction network: Computational and in vitro analysis.
off_label.summary: Artesunate, an existing drug, significantly reduced prostate cancer cell migration by 50% in laboratory tests, showing promise against metastasis.

off_label.title: Repurposing Purine Analog Antivirals to Modulate Serum Uric Acid: Evidence From Real-World Data.
off_label.summary: Common antiviral drugs may lower uric acid levels by blocking an enzyme involved in purine breakdown, offering a potential new treatment approach.

off_label.title: Combined Bisoprolol and Megestrol Acetate Improves Survival and Preserves Cardiac Performance in a Rat Model of Cancer Cachexia.
off_label.summary: A combination of two drugs improved survival and heart function in rats with cancer-related body wasting.

off_label.title: The Antipsychotic Aripiprazole Induces Cytotoxicity in Bladder Cancer Cells While Preserving Urothelial and Bladder Function.
off_label.summary: Aripiprazole, an antipsychotic drug, kills bladder cancer cells while preserving normal bladder structure and function in laboratory and animal tests.

off_label.title: Metformin as a Multifaceted Therapeutic Agent for Gastrointestinal Diseases: Mechanisms, Clinical Efficacy, and Future Directions.
off_label.summary: Metformin shows promise for treating multiple gastrointestinal diseases, including colorectal cancer and hepatocellular carcinoma, through anti-inflammatory and growth-inhibiting mechanisms.

off_label.title: Low-dose dihydroartemisinin resensitizes lung cancer cells to cisplatin by suppressing interleukin-6 release by macrophages.
off_label.summary: Low-dose artemisinin compound helps lung cancer cells respond better to cisplatin by reducing immune cell inflammation.

off_label.title: Mechanism-Driven Repurposing of All-Trans Retinoic Acid (ATRA) for AML1-MTG16⁺ Acute Myeloid Leukemia: A First-in-Human Case Report and Translational Roadmap to Overcome the 'Long-Tail' Barrier.
off_label.summary: Researchers repurposed an existing drug (ATRA) to treat rare acute myeloid leukemia by restoring normal cell differentiation.

biomarkers.title: Do BKPyV genomic features underlie clinical divergence between kidney and hematopoietic transplant recipients?
biomarkers.summary: Host immune factors, not viral genetics, primarily determine whether BK polyomavirus causes kidney damage or bladder bleeding in transplant patients.

biomarkers.title: Clinical manifestations and ultrasonographic features of lobular endocervical glandular hyperplasia: a retrospective study of 135 patients.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers identified ultrasound imaging features that help detect early cervical cancer precursor lesions in 135 patients.

biomarkers.title: Cathepsin S regulates germinal center reactions and anti-tumor humoral responses.
biomarkers.summary: Cathepsin S enzyme activity balances immune responses, preventing lymphoma while boosting anti-tumor antibody production in lung and colorectal cancers.

biomarkers.title: Aquaporin-1 sustains lymphangiogenic responses in hyperosmotic inflammatory microenvironments.
biomarkers.summary: A water channel protein called AQP1 enables intestinal lymph vessels to adapt to high-salt, inflammatory environments and absorb dietary fats.

biomarkers.title: Human germline biallelic loss-of-function OSMR variants cause severe allergic disease.
biomarkers.summary: Mutations in the OSMR gene cause severe allergic skin disease by impairing immune cell signaling pathways.

biomarkers.title: Crotonylation impedes c-Myc oncogenic activity.
biomarkers.summary: A chemical modification called crotonylation reduces c-Myc cancer protein activity, and mutations blocking this modification increase cancer risk.

biomarkers.title: HLA micropolymorphisms confine neoantigen conformational adaptability and guide T cell receptor selectivity.
biomarkers.summary: Small HLA protein differences alter cancer neoantigen shape, preventing immune cells from recognizing the same mutation across different HLA types.

biomarkers.title: A targeted combination therapy achieves effective pancreatic cancer regression and prevents tumor resistance.
biomarkers.summary: Combining three targeted drugs—targeting KRAS, EGFR, and STAT3—completely shrinks pancreatic tumors and prevents treatment resistance.

biomarkers.title: [Key points and interpretation of Chinese expert's consensus on endocrine therapy of breast cancer (2026 edition)].
biomarkers.summary: Chinese experts updated 2026 guidelines for breast cancer hormone therapy, expanding CDK4/6 inhibitor use and improving treatment precision across disease stages.

biomarkers.title: Racial disparities in the survival outcomes of craniopharyngioma: a 17-year population-based analysis.
biomarkers.summary: Black and Hispanic craniopharyngioma patients experience worse survival rates than white patients, highlighting significant racial disparities in outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Symptomatic manifestation of a cauda equina arteriovenous fistula after resection of a coexisting spinal schwannoma: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: A rare spinal nerve bundle fistula became symptomatic only after surgical removal of a coexisting benign tumor.

biomarkers.title: Bilateral dumbbell-shaped ganglioneuroma of the C2 roots in a patient with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease: illustrative case.
biomarkers.summary: Doctors report the first known case of rare benign nerve tumors occurring with Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease.

biomarkers.title: 12‑weeks fisetin supplementation and interval resistance with aerobic training: changes in Maresin‑1 and inflammatory markers in men with obesity: a randomized controlled trial.
biomarkers.summary: Fisetin supplements combined with exercise training increased inflammation-resolving molecules and improved metabolic health in obese men.

biomarkers.title: Liver Aging Index: A Noninvasive Score for Liver Biological Aging and Liver-Related Outcomes in Multicohorts.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers developed a noninvasive test measuring liver biological aging that predicts mortality and liver cancer risk better than actual age.

biomarkers.title: Sustained stimulation with tumor necrosis factor-alpha regulates interleukin-8 production and gene transcription in gingival epithelial cells.
biomarkers.summary: Sustained TNF-alpha exposure increases interleukin-8 production in gum cells, revealing how oral tissues respond to prolonged inflammation.

trials.title: Identification of Novel Genetic Risk Variants Associated With Early-Onset Ischemic Stroke in Taiwan.
trials.summary: Researchers identified new genetic variants linked to early-onset stroke in younger Taiwanese adults aged 18-54.

trials.title: A targeted combination therapy achieves effective pancreatic cancer regression and prevents tumor resistance.
trials.summary: Combining three targeted drugs—targeting KRAS, EGFR, and STAT3—completely shrinks pancreatic tumors and prevents treatment resistance.

trials.title: [Key points and interpretation of Chinese expert's consensus on endocrine therapy of breast cancer (2026 edition)].
trials.summary: Chinese experts updated 2026 guidelines for breast cancer hormone therapy, expanding CDK4/6 inhibitor use and improving treatment precision across disease stages.

trials.title: Endoscopic endonasal approach for recurrent craniopharyngioma in adults.
trials.summary: Endoscopic surgery through the nose effectively treats recurrent craniopharyngioma tumors in adults with good outcomes.

trials.title: Endoscopic endonasal gross-total resection of pediatric craniopharyngioma invading the hypothalamus: rethinking the role of surgery.
trials.summary: Surgeons successfully removed entire pediatric brain tumors using minimally invasive nasal surgery without increasing complications compared to partial removal.

trials.title: Clinical outcomes and delayed proton therapy following endoscopic endonasal resection of large and giant pediatric craniopharyngiomas.
trials.summary: Endoscopic surgery followed by delayed proton therapy improved outcomes for children with large brain tumors called craniopharyngiomas.

trials.title: 12‑weeks fisetin supplementation and interval resistance with aerobic training: changes in Maresin‑1 and inflammatory markers in men with obesity: a randomized controlled trial.
trials.summary: Fisetin supplements combined with exercise training increased inflammation-resolving molecules and improved metabolic health in obese men.

trials.title: First-line envafolimab plus recombinant human-endostatin in advanced non-small cell lung cancer with PD-L1 tumor proportion score ≥1% (Endouble): A multicenter, prospective, single-arm, phase 2 trial.
trials.summary: A combination of two drugs showed promise as a first-line treatment for advanced lung cancer patients.

trials.title: Amivantamab in advanced non-small cell lung cancer with epidermal growth factor receptor exon 20 insertion mutations: Real-world data from the Italian ATLAS Registry.
trials.summary: Amivantamab shows promise as a new treatment for advanced lung cancer with specific EGFR mutations, based on real-world patient data.

trials.title: Bayesian Evaluation of Treatment Effect of Avelumab Plus Axitinib for Advanced Renal Cell Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Avelumab plus axitinib showed promising survival benefits over sunitinib for advanced kidney cancer, despite missing traditional statistical significance.

trials.title: A Personalised and Gamified Digital Decision Aid for Colorectal Cancer Screening: A Randomised Controlled Pilot Study.
trials.summary: A gamified digital tool helps more people decide to get colorectal cancer screening by making it personalized and engaging.

trials.title: A real-world data analysis of the impact of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential on therapeutic efficacy and adverse events of immune checkpoint inhibitors.
trials.summary: A blood cell mutation called CHIP may reduce how well immune cancer drugs work and increase serious side effects in advanced cancer patients.

trials.title: Top advances of the year: Radiopharmaceutical therapy for prostate cancer.
trials.summary: Radiopharmaceutical therapy advances in 2025 show targeted radiation treatments improve survival across prostate cancer stages, from early to advanced disease.

trials.title: Six-Month Visual Outcomes in Pediatric Optic Neuritis: A Multicenter Study From South Korea.
trials.summary: This study examined vision outcomes in Korean children with optic neuritis, emphasizing the importance of antibody testing for proper diagnosis and treatment.

trials.title: Pulmonary echinococcosis caused by Echinococcus canadensis G8 in a white-tailed deer (Odocoileus virginianus), Pennsylvania, USA, 2026.
trials.summary: Echinococcus canadensis parasite found in Pennsylvania deer, indicating emerging infection risk to humans and animals in eastern USA.
